stories.title: Latest news, buzz from training camps: Kirk Cousins' best day of camp; Christian McCaffrey did not practice
stories.summary: Get all the news, intel and insights on NFL training camps from our team of reporters in the field.

stories.title: Sources: Cowboys, Williams reach $105.9M deal
stories.summary: The Cowboys and star defensive tackle Quinnen Williams have agreed to terms on a three-year, $105.9 million extension to make him one of the highest-paid defensive linemen in the NFL, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Carrington: Did not link ejection to white privilege
stories.summary: DiJonai Carrington says she never claimed that the assessment of a flagrant foul 2 on her in a game vs. the Fever was the result of white privilege.

stories.title: Greek team pursuing Jokic; made 'serious' offer
stories.summary: The owner of Panathinaikos Basketball Club in Athens, Greece, says he tried to buy Nikola Jokic out of his NBA contract for next season and believes he can sign the three-time MVP when he becomes a free agent next summer.

stories.title: Macdonald confirms Seattle's interest in CB Arnold
stories.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday the team has interest in signing Terrion Arnold after meeting with the embattled free agent cornerback over the weekend.
